column1: # Where each line of the upper band (the machine transcript) starts: the time, in seconds, of its first word in the
# first speech pass. Only the break points are chosen here, so that a line ends where a phrase ends; the words come
# from ../40_checked_by_ear/compared.json. build.py stops if a time is not the start of a word, or if a part of the
# clip (L1 ... L8) does not start a line.
